title: The best budget gaming keyboard is the one that fits your desk and habits.

description: Build a better PC gaming setup with research-led UK picks for keyboards, mice, headsets, monitor arms, lighting and cable management, organised by budget.
text: Home › Guides › Best PC gaming setup Search The complete SetupFinds guide Best PC gaming setup accessories for every budget A better setup is not about buying everything. It is about fixing the parts that affect control, comfort and clutter first. By SetupFinds Editorial Team Updated 20 October 2026 12-minute read Jump to a section Quick picks Choose a budget What to upgrade Optimise your desk How we choose FAQs Build around the problem, not the trend Start with the weakest part of your current setup. A poor mouse shape, uncomfortable headset or badly positioned monitor will matter more than decorative upgrades. Our shortlist is organised around practical use cases and clear trade-offs. How to read this guide: these are research-based recommendations, not claims of hands-on testing. Use each product page to check suitability, then confirm the exact version, seller and live price on Amazon. Shortlist Best gaming setup upgrades at a glance 01 Keyboard · Clean wireless pick Logitech G515 LIGHTSPEED TKL A compact, low-profile choice for a tidy gaming desk. Read buying guide → 02 Mouse · Best-value wireless mouse Logitech G305 LIGHTSPEED A sensible starting point for cable-free PC gaming. Read buying guide → 03 Headset · Straightforward wired audio HyperX Cloud III A comfort-focused option for PC and console chat. Read buying guide → 04 PS5 storage · PS5 storage upgrade WD_BLACK SN850X with Heatsink A practical way to make room for a larger game library. Read buying guide → 05 Desk upgrade · Space-saving desk pick Invision Monitor Arm Improves screen positioning while reclaiming desk space. Read buying guide → 06 Lighting · Focused desk lighting Quntis Monitor Light Bar Adds task lighting without using more desk surface. Read buying guide → Spend in the right order Choose your setup budget Starter Fix the essentials Prioritise a dependable mouse, a comfortable headset and cable control. Keep the keyboard you already have if it works well. Start with mice → Balanced Upgrade daily comfort Add a compact keyboard, better monitor positioning and useful desk lighting after the core controls are sorted. Improve the desk → Premium Pay for features you use Adjustable switches, premium wireless audio and extra controls make sense only when they match your games and habits. Compare all gear → Buying order What should you upgrade first? 01 Mouse and mouse space Shape and comfort come before maximum sensor numbers. Match the mouse to your grip, hand size and game style, then leave enough clear desk space. Compare wireless mice → 02 Keyboard layout A tenkeyless layout creates more room for mouse movement. Choose switches and key height by preference rather than assuming expensive means better. Compare keyboards → 03 Headset comfort Weight, clamping pressure and platform compatibility matter during long sessions. Decide whether wireless convenience is worth the extra cost. Compare headsets → 04 Monitor position and lighting A monitor arm can reclaim desk space, while a light bar can reduce the contrast between a bright screen and a dark room. Explore desk upgrades → No-cost improvements Optimise the setup you already own Centre the display: keep the main screen directly in front of your usual seated position. Make mouse room: move chargers and accessories away from your dominant-hand side. Control cables: route power separately from frequently moved charging cables. Protect comfort: place controls where shoulders stay relaxed and wrists are not forced upward. Change one thing at a time: it becomes easier to tell whether an upgrade genuinely helped. Our methodology How SetupFinds chooses products We compare the intended use case, stated specifications, compatibility, product variants and recurring buyer considerations. We favour products that solve a clear problem and explain drawbacks that could make them the wrong choice. We do not publish made-up star ratings, copy Amazon customer reviews or claim hands-on testing we have not performed. Read our full selection process → Common questions PC gaming setup FAQs What should I buy first for a gaming setup? Start with the item causing the biggest comfort or control problem. For many players that is the mouse, headset or monitor position—not decoration. Is wireless gear good enough for gaming? Modern gaming-focused wireless products can be a practical choice. Check connection type, charging or battery requirements and platform compatibility before buying. Do I need an expensive mechanical keyboard? No. Layout, switch feel and reliability matter more than price alone. A modest keyboard that suits your preferences can be the better purchase. How do the Amazon links work? Product buttons take you to Amazon, where you can check the exact listing, live price and seller. SetupFinds may earn a commission from qualifying purchases at no extra cost to you.
